Get comprehensive user exam status including:
- Completed exams with scores and performance data
- In-progress exams with start time and session details
- Not started exams with exam information
- Overall completion statistics and percentages
- Sorted by status (completed, in-progress, not started) then by exam name
Get user's completed exams only (for backward compatibility). Returns list of completed exams with scores and performance data.

Get comprehensive statistics for a specific exam including:
- Overall statistics (total attempts, completion rates)
- Score analysis (average, highest, lowest, median, standard deviation)
- Time analysis (average time spent, fastest/slowest completion)
- Accuracy statistics
- Performance trends (monthly/weekly)
- Score distribution
- Recent attempts
- Question analysis

Get all completed exam results with detailed information including:
- Username (retrieved from User entity)
- Exam name and type
- Comprehensive result summary (score percentage, accuracy, correct/incorrect answers)
- Start and end dates
- Total time spent
- Detailed answers for each question (user answer, correct answer, time spent, explanations)
- Time expiration and completion status

Returns all exam sessions that are marked as completed, sorted by start time (most recent first).

Get detailed scoring breakdown for an exam session including:
- Right and wrong answers
- Penalty calculation
- Error calculation
- Raw score before rounding
- Rounded score after applying rounding rules
- Percentile mapping
- Rounding method used

Shows the complete scoring calculation process with penalty-based formulas.

Get the complete score-to-percentile mapping table for an exam.

Returns all score ranges and their corresponding percentiles:
- Range formats: < N, <= N, > N, >= N, A - B, N (exact)
- Percentile values from 1 to 99
- Used for professional assessment reporting

Get exam configuration details including:
- Penalty value used for scoring
- Rounding method (half_up, none)
- Scoring rules and parameters

Configuration follows the Label Intelligence Assessment specification.

Creates a new evaluation group for Parent, Teacher, or Sibling/Friend evaluators.

Group Types:
- Parent: For parent evaluators
- Teacher: For teacher evaluators
- SiblingFriend: For sibling or friend evaluators

Returns:
- Evaluation group details
- Invitation token (32-character secure token)
- Invitation URL
- Token expiry date (2 days from creation)
- Status flags (isTokenUsed, isEvaluationCompleted)

Validates an invitation token and returns evaluator information.

Checks:
- Token existence
- Token expiry (2-day validity)
- Token usage status

Returns:
- Token validity status
- Evaluator details (name, email, relation, group type)
- Evaluated user ID
- Token expiry date

Retrieves all evaluation groups for a specific user.

Returns:
- List of all evaluation groups
- Each group includes:
  - Evaluator details (name, email, relation, group type)
  - Invitation token and URL
  - Token expiry date
  - Status flags (isTokenUsed, isEvaluationCompleted)
  - Creation date

Use this for dashboard tracking and monitoring evaluation progress.
Example: Create evaluation group for a parent (mother)
Example: Create evaluation group for a teacher
Example: Create evaluation group for a sibling or friend

Updates an existing evaluation group.

Validation Rules:
- Cannot edit if token is already used
- Cannot have duplicate relations for same user
- Cannot use same email in same group type
- Evaluated user must exist

Returns:
- Updated evaluation group details
- Invitation token (preserved)
- Invitation URL
- Token expiry date
- Status flags

Deletes an evaluation group (soft delete).

Validation Rules:
- Cannot delete if token is already used
- Evaluation group must exist and be active

Returns:
- Deletion confirmation
- Evaluator details (name, email)
- Deletion timestamp

Note: This performs a soft delete by setting IsActive to false.
